image_description: A white minibus with a high-roof conversion, parked on a dirt or gravel surface. The vehicle features a row of side windows, a large windshield, and visible text/logos on the side and front. Several people are standing in the background to the left. The image quality is low resolution with noticeable compression artifacts.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side ('...tun...') and front header is illegible and morphologically inconsistent, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear branding.
The people in the background lack distinct anatomical definition, appearing as melted color blobs. The ground texture is overly smooth and lacks realistic gravel detail.
The front grille and headlight assembly lack sharp geometric definition, appearing slightly warped and fused with the bumper.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifacts. In real images, low resolution causes blur, but AI generation often causes character morphing. Differentiate between simple JPEG compression and generative text failure. Also, evaluate if the 'melted' background figures are due to image resolution or generative structural failure.
